applicant.name: Dr. Pieter de Vries
applicant.organisation: Medical University of Warsaw, Cardiology Research Unit

request.purpose: Scientific research on medication use and treatment gaps in routine care.
request.question: Average latest body mass index of patients with depression, by sex.
definitions: Depression = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with F32.
BMI is the most recent value of LOINC 39156-5 for each patient; patients without a BMI are left out.
Report per sex: patients with depression who have a BMI and their average BMI, one decimal.
